summary: Lund University's Global Scholarship can cover part or all of the tuition fee for citizens outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland. How much depends on your programme or faculty's budget. It is a two-step application, and the scholarship step usually opens in early February.
meta_title: Lund University Global Scholarship: part or all of your tuition
meta_description: Lund's Global Scholarship covers part or all of tuition. Apply with Lund first by 15 January 2027. Lund has not yet published its 2027 scholarship dates.
covers: Part or all of the tuition fee; the share depends on the programme or faculty budget.
eligibility: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who must pay tuition fees.
Applicants to a master's in the regular round or, exceptionally, the bachelor's programmes in Development Studies, Mathematics, Physics or Physical Geography.
A Lund programme must be your first choice on universityadmissions.se.
You must meet Lund's admission requirements and be able to fund your living costs.
how_to_apply: Apply to a Lund programme on universityadmissions.se by 15 January 2027, with Lund first, a complete application and the fee paid.
Then apply through Lund's scholarship portal. Lund posts the link when the period opens, which is usually in early February.
Upload a Scholarship Motivation Letter of up to 600 words. You may apply for one scholarship per round.
watch_out: Lund has not published the 2027 scholarship dates. The last deadline was 16 February 2026, so watch its page from January.
A grant may cover only part of the fee.
You must be able to pay your own living costs.
costs: Part or all, if you win the scholarship; you pay any remainder

documents: Your universityadmissions.se application, complete and with the fee paid.
A Scholarship Motivation Letter of up to 600 words.

faq.q: Does the Lund Global Scholarship cover all of tuition?
faq.a: It may. Lund says grants may cover part or all of the tuition fee, depending on the programme or faculty budget. It does not cover living costs.

Lund has not published its 2027 scholarship dates yet. You need to apply to your programme by 15 January 2027 first. The scholarship usually opens in early February, and the last deadline was 16 February 2026.
